newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains firmer helped by sterling.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains firmer helped by sterling.

text.p: LIFFE grains firmed in subuded trade.
Sterling's stability at its new lower level against the mark helped lift the market, traders said.
On wheat, November dominated with 261 of 400 lots done. It last traded 0.50 stg higher at 84.70 stg.
One good buyer on November helped lift the market, "by perhaps more than it should have been on the basis of sterling," one trader said.
November was also most active on barley, with 26 of 51 lots. November barley last traded 0.75 stg higher at 80.00 stg.
